meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接管理重构:先确认你的目标,再扫描代码库建依赖图、评估测试覆盖,然后分步改代码,每步跑测试和诊断,最后做一轮回归检查。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取等代码改动时触发;入口是 /refactor 命令,可带上目标、作用域和策略参数。

say.text: /refactor 把校验逻辑抽成独立模块
say.note: 先跟你确认理解再动手。

howto.what_en: Claude takes over refactors: it confirms your goal, maps dependencies, checks test coverage, changes code step by step, runs tests and diagnostics after each step, and ends with a full regression check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code; the entry point is the /refactor command with a target, scope and strategy flag.

say_en.note: Touches one file, runs tests after.

say_en.text: /refactor extract validation into its own module
